blocks.text: Designed for women seeking comprehensive digestive, immune, and vaginal health support, Garden of Life Once Daily Dr. Formulated Probiotics for Women delivers a specialized formula in a once-daily capsule. Each serving provides 50 Billion CFU from 16 diverse probiotic strains, including clinically studied L. reuteri and L. fermentum to support vaginal health and pH balance.* This dietary supplement includes a whole food prebiotic fiber blend to promote beneficial bacteria growth as well as digestive and immune function support.* Doctor Formulated by David Perlmutter, M.D., a leading microbiome expert, these probiotics for women are shelf-stable, ensuring strains arrive alive and stay viable. Adults take one capsule daily with or without food, or the vegetarian capsule can be opened and mixed into water or beverages for convenience. Third-Party Certified Non-GMO and Gluten-Free, this probiotic is gluten free. Choose Garden of Life for a premium probiotics supplement designed specifically for women's health. *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
